contributions.anchor: the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL 26,231.39' on p3, equal to the cover's Cumulative Total cell (26,231.39) - which on this filing also equals This Report, because Last Report is 0.00
contributions.detail: 9 Itemized Contribution Report rows sum to 26,231.39 exactly = the schedule's printed TOTAL = the cover's This-Report AND Cumulative cells (both 26,231.39; Last Report 0.00, so this convention report opens the cycle and the two columns coincide). 2026 is the 3-line variant: one contributions cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line. IN-KIND CONVENTION TESTED BOTH WAYS: the two rows the filer tags '(in-kind)' (931.39 Precision Care and 11,600.00 Precision Care) are INCLUDED - monetary-only would give 13,700.00 and miss the printed total by 12,531.39, so this filer includes in-kind, and the corroborating evidence is on Form B, where the SAME two amounts appear as expenditures (Weber County filing fee 931.39, Gathering Inc signatures 11,600.00): the in-kind goods were the payments themselves.

expenditures.anchor: the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL 13,742.18' on p4, equal to the cover's Cumulative cell (written '13.742.18' by the filer) and to This Report (13,742.18)
expenditures.detail: 17 Itemized Expenditures Report rows sum to 13,742.18 exactly = the schedule's printed TOTAL = the cover's This-Report cell; Last Report is 0.00 so Cumulative is the same figure. The handwritten cover writes the cumulative expenditure cell as '13.742.18' with a period where the thousands comma belongs - that is a WRITING defect in the cover cell, not an arithmetic one, and it does not touch this side's reconciliation, which gates on the typed schedule TOTAL.

escalation_note: Five 900 dpi tight --value crops, all A3 indexing proofs: p3 row 1 rendered 931.39 and p3 row 9 rendered 5,000.00; p4 row 1 rendered 25.00 and p4 row 17 rendered 125.00; p4 row 10 (one of the three bands I had to extrapolate) rendered 12.90, confirming the extrapolation as well as the endpoints.

3.measure_note: This is a spreadsheet PRINTOUT with hairline grid rules; rowbands detected no v_rules at all and only a partial set of h_rules, so the AMOUNT column band [52.0,64.5] is HAND-MEASURED off the 200 dpi full-page render and crop-proven, and each row band is hand-built as the detected text-line position +/-0.85 pct. IMPORTANT SHAPE: the schedule prints each entry as a TWO- OR THREE-LINE BLOCK (name line carrying the date and amount, then the redacted street line where present, then the city/state line); the 9 stored bands are the 9 AMOUNT-BEARING lines, one per entry, index-aligned with row 1..9 - they are not every printed line on the sheet. The detected h_rules 20.27/25.63/30.97/34.50/37.94/41.61/45.23/48.71/52.23 are exactly those 9 lines and were used as the band centres; the header block above and the TOTAL line at ~57.4 pct are excluded. PROOF (A3): pct:52.0,19.42,12.5,1.7@p3 rendered '931.39' (row 1) and pct:52.0,51.38,12.5,1.7@p3 rendered '5,000.00' (row 9).

4.measure_note: Same spreadsheet-printout family, no v_rules and only 14 of the 17 amount lines detected. The printed pitch is constant at 3.955 pct, so the three undetected lines (entries 5, 10 and 14) were EXTRAPOLATED between their detected neighbours (31.72, 51.76, 67.50) and the rest use the detected positions; every band is centre +/-0.9 pct. The extrapolation was PROVEN, not assumed: pct:45.3,50.86,12.4,1.8@p4 (entry 10) rendered '12.90', the recorded amount. Endpoint PROOF (A3): pct:45.3,14.92,12.4,1.8@p4 rendered '25.00' (row 1) and pct:45.3,78.5,12.4,1.8@p4 rendered '125.00' (row 17). The header block and the TOTAL line at ~85.3 pct are excluded from the band list.

notes: 2026 Weber form: p1 is the HANDWRITTEN cover, p2 a typed Campaign Financial Summary restating it, p3 the typed Itemized Contribution Report, p4 the typed Itemized Expenditures Report - the schedules are spreadsheet printouts, not the county's Form A/Form B grid, and they carry no line numbers of their own (line_no is the 1-based position on the schedule). Office is written on the cover ('County Commission - Seat B') though index.csv leaves office_stated blank. PRIVACY: donor street lines are not carried; on rows 1 and 2 the street line is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (redaction at source) while every other row simply has no street line - two different facts, distinguished in the row notes. Row 3's locality line reads only 'Oregon', which is neither a city nor a US state abbreviation, so donor_city and donor_state are honestly blank. Form B's locality is printed as one 'City ST' string and is carried verbatim in vendor_city, including its non-city values ('Internet'). Two vendor spellings are the filer's own ('pens . com') and are kept verbatim. The cover's own headings are mangled by the scan's text layer ('FilingSchedule(CheckOne') - a text-layer artefact only; the printed page is legible.
